# Customer churn analysis
Shared notebook for the retention team. Churn is defined as no purchase in the last 90 days.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

customers = pd.read_csv("data/customers.csv")
orders = pd.read_csv("data/orders.csv", parse_dates=["order_date"])
customers.head()

orders_per_customer = orders.groupby("customer_id").agg(n_orders=("order_id", "count"), last_order=("order_date", "max"))
df = customers.merge(orders_per_customer, on="customer_id", how="left")
CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2026-10-01")
df["churned"] = (CUTOFF - df["last_order"]).dt.days > 90
Note: `region` and `plan` have some missing values; `age` is self-reported.
